subject: Animation
title: Moana and Cultural Representation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Moana and Cultural Representation.

hook.text: Disney assembled a trust of Pacific Islander scholars and navigators to guide Moana's creation.

buildup.text: The studio wanted to celebrate Polynesian culture authentically rather than just borrow aesthetics.

discovery.text: Moana featured no love interest. Her journey was about identity, leadership, and honoring ancestors.

twist.text: Despite the research, some Pacific Islanders criticized the portrayal of Maui as a stereotype.

climax.text: Moana earned over $600 million and showed Disney that diverse storytelling had global appeal.

punchline.text: Authentic cultural storytelling sailed to global success.

quiz.question: What was distinctive about Disney's approach to creating Moana?
options: They used an entirely AI-generated script
They assembled a trust of Pacific Islander scholars for authentic cultural representation
They filmed the movie entirely on location
